verdict.rationale: TrueLayer documents webhooks that notify you when Payments API events occur, and mandates on which payments execute without further user authorisation. These are developer building blocks: you still have to write your own rule logic in your own system. No first-party feature lets a user define event-to-action rules. The one-line mention of configuring sweeping in Console has no detail showing it is an event-triggered rule, so it counts only as an adjacent control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
